title: Fruit Juice Concentrate
name: Fruit juice concentrate
aliases: fruit juice concentrate, concentrated fruit juice, fruit concentrate, apple juice concentrate, grape juice concentrate, pear juice concentrate
what_is: Fruit juice from which water has been removed, concentrating the natural sugars. Used as a sweetener in processed foods while allowing manufacturers to label products as containing 'fruit' or 'no added sugar'.
why_botia: WHO classifies fruit juice concentrates as free sugars. They are chemically similar to added sugar but benefit from a health halo. A product labelled 'no added sugar' can still contain concentrated fruit juice as its primary sweetener.
can_1: Detect fruit juice concentrates on ingredient labels.
can_2: Flag products using fruit concentrates as primary sweeteners despite 'no added sugar' claims.
can_3: Categorise them as WHO free sugar (fruit concentrate group).
cannot_1: Distinguish between different types of fruit concentrate used.
cannot_2: Quantify the exact sugar content from the concentrate alone.
cannot_3: Tell you the total sugar content — check the nutrition label.
